name: NaviCloud
subtitle: Navidrome client for Android + Windows
summary: A music client for Navidrome / Subsonic servers, built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose. Streaming, playlists, equalizer and audio effects — same app on Android and Windows. What I spend most of my side-project time on right now.

name: Fallout 1 CE — PS3
subtitle: Fallout 1 running natively on PS3
summary: A native PS3 homebrew port of Fallout 1, built on Fallout Community Edition. Not an emulator — the engine is cross-compiled for the Cell PPU and rendered through an RSX-backed SDL2 backend. Runs on PS3HEN and RPCS3, tested on real hardware.

name: Snip
subtitle: Screenshot utility for Windows
summary: Region screenshots that become floating, always-on-top reference windows you can zoom and pan. Also drops clipboard images into the active Explorer folder as PNGs when you paste. Single static executable, lives in the tray.

name: Fallout 4 Save Rescuer
subtitle: Fixes FO4 saves with missing mods
summary: Repairs Fallout 4 saves that stopped loading because their mods are gone — rewrites the plugin lists and form IDs so the save no longer depends on the missing content. Writes the result as a new save; the original is never touched.

name: FM - File Manager
subtitle: File manager in Tauri + Vue + Rust
summary: A cross-platform file manager built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust. Handles navigation, multi-select, inline rename, file ops, virtual locations, and per-directory view persistence.

name: Toolbelt
subtitle: Small tools I keep reaching for
summary: A collection of utilities I kept needing — encoder, markdown notepad, HTTP client, hasher, alarm clock, and a few others. Built for myself, open sourced in case it's useful to anyone else.

name: React Multiwatch
subtitle: Watch multiple streams at once
summary: Watch multiple YouTube streams in a resizable grid. Keyboard shortcuts let you rearrange the layout and control playback across all of them at the same time.

name: PS3Dec GUI
subtitle: A GUI for the PS3Dec tool
summary: A Windows GUI wrapped around PS3Dec, the command-line tool for decrypting PS3 game ISOs. If you don't want to deal with a terminal for this, here you go.

name: Number Station Generator
subtitle: Unreal Engine 5 audio experiment
summary: An UE5 plugin that generates number-station style audio — procedural, atmospheric, a bit eerie. Built mostly out of curiosity.

name: Subliminal UI
subtitle: Desktop subtitle downloader
summary: A desktop GUI for the Subliminal subtitle library. Sits in the system tray, watches your media folders, and pulls subtitles automatically — no command line needed.

name: Clipwatch
subtitle: Clipboard image saver for Windows
summary: Watches your clipboard for images and saves them as files when you hit Ctrl+V in an Explorer window. Drops the image into whatever folder you have open, or the desktop if nothing's focused.

name: YTMP3 Android
subtitle: YouTube to MP3 on Android
summary: An Android app for downloading YouTube audio as MP3. Ships with a youtube-dl based backend server — install it, point the app at it, and you're good.
